maren.name: Maren Holst
maren.workshop_note: Visits often and likes to watch the model output scroll.
maren.mechanical_role: Primary source of oral history fragments. Prefers Vera hand-write her recordings rather than transcribing via Tool.
maren.arc_summary: Episodic memory loss. Player helps her record what she remembers before she loses it.

eli.name: Eli Sato
eli.mechanical_role: Required to repair damaged storage media. Vera can run her models without Eli; she cannot recover damaged Caches without him.
eli.arc_summary: His twin sister Ren left five years ago looking for a research site and never returned. Her path leads toward the Holdout theory.

sable.name: Sable
sable.role: Gardener, head of the community plot
sable.workshop_note: Will not enter the workshop. Polite about it. Not flexible.
sable.mechanical_role: No direct mechanical dependency. Late-game philosophical question to Vera; player-selected answer shapes their arc.
sable.arc_summary: Believes Vera's tools are descended from the wrong line. Late arc question: do you ever wonder if the thing that helps you is the thing that helped end us?

wren.name: Wren Ashby
wren.workshop_note: Openly hostile to the Tools at game start. Not to Vera — she respects competence.
wren.mechanical_role: No hard mechanical gate. Her arc opens narrative content late-game.
wren.arc_summary: Slow resistance arc. Cracked open by a specific Cache relic. Does not become an evangelist — becomes someone who changed her mind about one specific thing.

doss.name: Doss Okafor
doss.mechanical_role: Reads chapters of his history book to the player. Arc ends with the book added to the Catalogue — the newest item in an archive of old things, and the only one made without machines.
doss.arc_summary: Writing a history of Ashford as fiction, by hand, no digital draft.

petra.name: Petra Vance
petra.mechanical_role: Co-builds the Medical Post (Tier 2). Has a salvaged medical reference system she uses and is not happy about using.
petra.arc_summary: Navigates the ethical weight of using pre-war AI tools for patient care.

corvus.name: Corvus
corvus.mechanical_role: Accepts Echo-reconstructed audio for his composition only if Vera tells him exactly what the model did. His piece is performed at the Broadcast sequence.
corvus.arc_summary: Composing a piece from Catalogue fragments. Will not perform a hallucination; will perform a careful guess, if told it was careful.
